title: Internal safety committee memo: NX-14 safety review (2024)
body: Monthly safety review of NX-14 development program. No unexpected adverse events have been reported in the Phase 2 IPF trial. Hepatic and renal function remain normal in 99% of patients. Gastrointestinal side effects are mild and transient. No dose-limiting toxicities identified. Recommendation: continue to Phase 2b expansion.
